steps.eval: __rhf.start(false)
(() => { const a = __rhf.game.announcer; return 'default: ' + a.voiceName + ' (game voice ' + a.gameVoice + '), sound running ' + !!(__rhf.game.audio.ctx && __rhf.game.audio.ready); })()

(() => { const a = __rhf.game.announcer; if (!a.clips.__spied) { const orig = a.clips.say.bind(a.clips); a.clips.say = (line, sub, gain) => { window.__clipCalls = (window.__clipCalls || []); const p = orig(line, sub, gain); p.then((ok) => window.__clipCalls.push({ line, sub, ok, sources: a.clips.sources.length, secs: a.clips.sources.map((s) => s.buffer.duration.toFixed(2)).join(' + ') })); return p; }; a.clips.__spied = true; } return 'watching the game voice'; })()
(() => { const g = __rhf.game; g.announcer.lastKey = null; g.announcer.say('newSpecies', { sub: 'NORTHERN PIKE!' }); return 'said NEW SPECIES! NORTHERN PIKE!'; })()

(() => { const c = (window.__clipCalls || []).slice(-1)[0]; return c ? 'game voice played "' + c.line + '"' + (c.sub ? ' then "' + c.sub + '"' : '') + ': ok ' + c.ok + ', ' + c.sources + ' clip(s), ' + c.secs + ' s' : 'no game voice call'; })() + '; device speech: ' + (() => { const s = window.__spoken[window.__spoken.length - 1]; return s ? '"' + s.text + '" in ' + s.voice + ' (' + s.lang + ')' : 'nothing through the device voice'; })()
(() => { const A = __rhf.game.audio; return 'the place and the music while it talks: ' + A.bed.gain.value.toFixed(2) + ' (1 = full), speaking ' + __rhf.game.announcer.clips.speaking; })()
(() => { const A = __rhf.game.audio; return 'after it: ' + A.bed.gain.value.toFixed(2) + ', speaking ' + __rhf.game.announcer.clips.speaking; })()
(() => { const g = __rhf.game; g.announcer.lastKey = null; g.announcer.say('best', { sub: '4.2 KG KING SALMON' }); return 'said PERSONAL BEST! 4.2 KG KING SALMON'; })()

(() => { const c = (window.__clipCalls || []).slice(-1)[0]; return c ? 'game voice played "' + c.line + '"' + (c.sub ? ' then "' + c.sub + '"' : '') + ': ok ' + c.ok + ', ' + c.sources + ' clip(s), ' + c.secs + ' s' : 'no game voice call'; })()
(() => { const g = __rhf.game; g.announcer.lastKey = null; g.announcer.say('treasure', { sub: 'A NAME WITH NO RECORDING' }); return 'said TREASURE! and a name with no recording'; })()

(() => { const c = (window.__clipCalls || []).slice(-1)[0]; return c ? 'game voice played "' + c.line + '"' + (c.sub ? ' then "' + c.sub + '"' : '') + ': ok ' + c.ok + ', ' + c.sources + ' clip(s), ' + c.secs + ' s' : 'no game voice call'; })() + '; device speech: ' + (() => { const s = window.__spoken[window.__spoken.length - 1]; return s ? '"' + s.text + '" in ' + s.voice + ' (' + s.lang + ')' : 'nothing through the device voice'; })()

(async () => { const v = __rhf.game.announcer.clips; const all = v.allKeys(); let ok = 0, bad = [], secs = 0, longest = ['', 0]; for (const k of all) { try { const b = await v.decode(k); ok++; secs += b.duration; if (b.duration > longest[1]) longest = [k, b.duration]; } catch (e) { bad.push(k); } } return 'decoded ' + ok + ' of ' + all.length + ' clips, ' + secs.toFixed(1) + ' s in all, longest ' + longest[0] + ' ' + longest[1].toFixed(2) + ' s; failed: ' + (bad.join(', ') || 'none') + '; kept decoded now: ' + v.buffers.size; })()

(() => { const a = __rhf.game.announcer; const missing = []; for (const [k, list] of Object.entries(a.lines)) for (const [t] of list) if (!a.clips.has(t)) missing.push(t); return 'announcer lines without a recording: ' + (missing.join(', ') || 'none'); })()
(() => { __rhf.game.screens.open('settings'); return 'Settings open: voice button reads ' + document.getElementById('s-voice').textContent; })()

'after a tap on Voice: ' + document.getElementById('s-voice').textContent + '; sample: ' + (() => { const s = window.__spoken[window.__spoken.length - 1]; return s ? '"' + s.text + '" in ' + s.voice + ' (' + s.lang + ')' : 'nothing through the device voice'; })()

'after a second tap: ' + document.getElementById('s-voice').textContent + '; sample: ' + (() => { const s = window.__spoken[window.__spoken.length - 1]; return s ? '"' + s.text + '" in ' + s.voice + ' (' + s.lang + ')' : 'nothing through the device voice'; })()
(() => { const a = __rhf.game.announcer; const names = []; for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) names.push(a.nextVoice()); return 'and on round: ' + names.join(' > '); })()

(() => { const a = __rhf.game.announcer; let guard = 0; while (a.voiceName !== 'Daniel' && guard++ < 10) a.nextVoice(); __rhf.game.screens.close(); __rhf.game.state.flags.voiceHint = false; a.lastKey = null; a.say('fishOn'); return 'with Daniel picked, a fish on: ' + (() => { const s = window.__spoken[window.__spoken.length - 1]; return s ? '"' + s.text + '" in ' + s.voice + ' (' + s.lang + ')' : 'nothing through the device voice'; })(); })()
'note for a device voice on an iPhone: ' + [...document.querySelectorAll('#toasts .toast')].map((t) => t.textContent).join(' / ')

(() => { const st = __rhf.game.state.settings; delete st.gameVoice; st.voiceName = 'Daniel'; localStorage.setItem('rubenHotrodFishing.settings.v1', JSON.stringify({ volume: 0.8, music: 0.55, announcer: true, voiceName: 'Daniel' })); return 'saved settings from before the game voice, with Daniel picked'; })()
(() => { const st = __rhf.game.state.settings; return 'after a reload: voice ' + (st.voiceName || 'none picked') + ', so ' + __rhf.game.announcer.voiceName; })()
